title: Part C distributions and part D pre-floor region dumps, from the python replica on the pipeline's own rung-2 dumps
source_change: mesh_processing_headless.cpp:4365 only (already in the phase-1 commit); this phase changes no C++
why_the_replica: the pipeline passes the floor INTO growPaper234 (mesh_processing_headless.cpp:3647) so it cannot report the regions it discarded; replica37.py grows from the pipeline's own rung-2 dump (points, normals, theta/kappa/nb/floor read from the rung-2 sidecar) and reports the distribution before the floor

arms.NA: no spacing environment + SFS_NORMAL_SOURCE=input SFS_NORMAL_CARRY=nearest -- the part C main column: adaptive spacing, honest nearest-carry normals
arms.PDN: NA + a rung-2 dump and --partd: the same column as NA, written out as one PLY and one json per piece for part D (Juglet 2, Juglet 9, Pot_A 07)
arms.FX: SFS_SPACING_POLICY=fixed + nearest-carry -- the fixed 0.6 mm column, normals held, so the spacing is the only difference
arms.RA: SFS_SPACING_POLICY=piece only, i.e. the pipeline's own re-estimated normals + a replica run -- this IS the new default configuration and it is the config the replica must reproduce (Juglet 3, 5, 7, Pot_A 07)

replica_validation: replica37.py grows from the rung-2 dump and compares its survivors at floor_applied against the rung-2 sidecar 'clusters' list. MATCH exact / NEAR same count and every pair within max(2 points, 10%) with the deltas written out / MISMATCH = the numbers are unvalidated and are reported as such
part_d_format: x y z nx ny nz cluster_id int reason uchar, the ticket-25 rung-2 layout, ids ordered by size (0 = largest); reason 1 = seed, 3 = grown member; the growth partitions the cloud so -1 never appears
